mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages (room_id, sender, recipient, content, timestamp, type) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{sender}, #{recipient}, #{content}, #{timestamp, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{type, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT id, room_id, sender, recipient, content, timestamp, type FROM chat_messages WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY timestamp ASC

SELECT id, room_id, sender, recipient, content, timestamp, type FROM chat_messages WHERE (sender = #{sender} AND recipient = #{recipient}) OR (sender = #{recipient} AND recipient = #{sender}) ORDER BY timestamp ASC
